NEWS for OFWs in Japan 🇯🇵
From April 2027, Japan replaces the Technical Intern Program (技能実習) with a new system: "Ikusei Shuro" (育成就労).
• 17 fields, including construction
• After about 3 years → Specified Skilled Worker (特定技能)
Source: Japanese Cabinet decision (Kyodo News, Sep 26, 2025)
